priorityList: Cast Arcane Intellect and Mirror Image before combat starts.
Use Counterspell to interrupt enemy casts.
Cast Arcane Surge on cooldown to initiate your primary burst window.
Use Touch of the Magi (off-GCD) while Arcane Surge is active or if it is on a long cooldown.
Sync Power Infusion, Potions, Racials, and Trinkets with your Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi window.
During Arcane Soul (the buff following Arcane Surge), prioritize casting Arcane Barrage.
Use Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Touch of the Magi is active, about to expire, or was just applied.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Arcane Salvo reaches 25 stacks.
Use Arcane Missiles whenever Clearcasting is active, especially during Arcane Surge or to prevent overcapping stacks.
Use Arcane Orb as your primary method to generate Arcane Charges whenever you have fewer than 2 charges.
Cast Arcane Pulse for AoE damage when facing at least 3 targets (or 4 targets if Orb Mastery is talented).
In AoE situations with 4 or more enemies, use Arcane Explosion to build charges if you have fewer than 2 charges and Arcane Orb is on cooldown.
Use Arcane Blast as your main filler to build Arcane Charges when other generators are unavailable.
Channel Evocation if your mana falls below 10% and Arcane Surge is not yet available.
Cast Arcane Barrage as a finisher to reset charges if no other high-priority actions are available.
